posts.title: PHP2Shell: patch your runtime now
bullets: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 can enable unauthenticated remote code execution.
The PHP project issued fixes on 21 October 2026.
Fixed upstream releases include PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.
posts.takeaway: Inventory PHP hosts and containers, patch and redeploy.
posts.caption: 🚨 PHP2Shell: the PHP project released fixes on 21 October for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, two critical PHP-engine vulnerabilities that may enable unauthenticated remote code execution. Fixed upstream versions: PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Audit internet-facing PHP runtimes, rebuild affected containers and deploy supported security updates. PHP2Shell is not a GitLab vulnerability. Sources: PHP project and GitLab Security Labs. #PHP #CyberSecurity #AppSec #VulnerabilityManagement

posts.title: GitLab issued a critical patch release
bullets: On 21 October, GitLab announced a critical security patch release.
Patched versions include 19.5.1, 19.4.3 and 19.3.6, with additional supported lines.
Self-managed admins should check the release advisory for the correct upgrade path.
posts.takeaway: Check your GitLab deployment and plan a verified update.
posts.caption: 🔐 GitLab announced a critical patch release on 21 October 2026. Published versions include 19.5.1, 19.4.3, 19.3.6, 19.2.9, 19.1.9, 19.0.10 and 18.11.13. Check your deployed release against GitLab's official advisory and upgrade the appropriate supported line. Source: GitLab release archive. #GitLab #DevSecOps #PatchManagement #CyberSecurity

posts.title: GitLab beta tracks AI agent activity
bullets: GitLab announced an AI Governance Dashboard beta on 20 October.
The dashboard links agent activity to users, sessions and projects.
Audit-event storage is off by default and requires activation.
posts.takeaway: Inventory agent tools and enable auditable oversight.
posts.caption: 🤖 AI agent governance is becoming an operational requirement. On 20 October, GitLab described its beta AI Governance Dashboard for viewing agent activity across its platform and connected tools. The dashboard can associate agents with sessions, projects and users. Important: AI audit-event storage must be enabled to capture events. Takeaway: govern identities, tool access and logs before scaling agentic development. Source: GitLab. #AISecurity #AgenticAI #DevSecOps #Governance
